style.styleTitle: Decoris Set of 2 Glass Tumbler Christmas Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Add a whimsical glow to your Christmas decor with these shimmering glass tumbler ornaments. Featuring a playful straw detail and a radiant sequin finish, these slim silhouettes catch the tree lights beautifully, adding modern depth to your Christmas display. Whether paired with classic baubles or minimalist accents, they serve as a cheerful, eye-catching highlight.</p><ul><li>Made of glass with a sequin finish<br></li><li>Tumbler shaped figure with decorative straw detail<br></li><li>Dimensions: length 5.1 cm, width 3.8 cm, height 10 cm<br></li><li>Fitted with silver aluminum cap in matching cap colour<br></li><li>Comes with silver wire for easy hanging in the Christmas tree</li></ul>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This glass figure is designed for decorating a Christmas tree with a fun and sparkling accent. The mug shape with straw decoration brings a playful touch that fits perfectly into a festive, modern theme. Shiny sequins in different colors reflect the tree lights and add lively depth among classic baubles and tinsel. On the tree, the slim mug silhouette stands out as a cheerful highlight that complements both simple and richly decorated arrangements. Made of glass with a shiny sequin finish. Mug-shaped figure with decorative straw detail. Dimensions: length 5.1 cm, width 3.8 cm, height 10 cm. Fitted with silver aluminum cap in matching cap colour. Comes with silver wire for easy hanging in the Christmas tree.
